plugins.name: anvil-document-sdk
plugins.description: Implement Anvil API integrations — PDF Filling, HTML-to-PDF Generation, Etch E-Sign, and Workflows — into any existing Node.js or TypeScript codebase. Guides developers through discovery, planning, and production-ready code generation.

plugins.name: dropbox-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing DropboxSign/HelloSign e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs, migrates templates, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: docusign-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing DocuSign eSignature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs, converts DocuSign templates directly to Anvil templates (preserving field geometry, types, and signer roles), rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: pandadoc-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing PandaDoc e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs (roles, fields, tokens), migrates templates via PDF rendering and Anvil Document AI, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: xodosign-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing Apryse Xodo Sign (formerly eversign) e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs (documents, signers, positioned fields, template merge fields, webhook events), migrates flat-PDF templates via Anvil Document AI, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: adobesign-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing Adobe Acrobat Sign (Adobe Sign / eSign REST API v6) integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps the OAuth + shard base-URI model to Anvil's single API key, converts library documents to Anvil templates (PDF + Document AI, with a dynamic-doc option), rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: signnow-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing signNow (airSlate SignNow) e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs, migrates templates via PDF download and Anvil Document AI, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: boldsign-anvil-migration
plugins.description: Migrate existing BoldSign e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs (documents, templates, roles, positioned form fields, embedded signing, webhooks), migrates templates via PDF download + Anvil Document AI, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.

plugins.name: anvil-document-templates
plugins.description: Create and manage Anvil document templates (Casts) at scale. Bulk-uploads PDFs as templates with Document AI field detection, applies field aliases from a CSV, and opens each new template in edit mode for review.
